title: Remove NERV's FPV data and code
goal: After the move, NERV has no FPV tables, rules or tests of its own
acceptance: NERV's battery, fleet, spares, crash and FPV build tables, src/battery-health.ts, src/battery-storage-reminders.ts, the FPV pack's data code (src/batteries.ts, src/fleet.ts, src/fpv-builds.ts, src/blackbox.ts, src/diyfpv-build.ts) and their tests are removed (no dead code); the tables are dropped by a migration only after F-101-T08's counts match
System and Gauntlet cases that used them are updated to the MCP path (Gauntlet's own cases through gauntlet's backlog)
npm test, check:fast and check:integrations stay green; the FPV pack still loads with only its MCP wiring
privacy: Owner fleet data stays local-only and never enters Git; tests use invented batteries, drones, crashes and photos.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
Dropping owner tables goes to the owner before the migration runs

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 after the owner decision (delete modules, tables and tests, update the cases). Not a measurement.
